svg.aria-label: BioDream: An offline AI companion that feels.
svg.title: BioDream
svg.desc: An offline AI companion that feels. A fine-tuned model running entirely on your phone, with a 16-dimension emotion engine, seven stages of closeness, and long-term memory that comes up only when it is relevant. No conversation ever leaves the device.
